_about: Research rulings for app-vs-record-book differences (keys: game_id|field, or season:date:opp|missing_in_app). truth = verified value; confidence high/medium/low; sources independent of the app's own pipeline where possible.

1995-16|site.truth: N (Kemper Arena, Kansas City, Mo.; Kansas-hosted game away from Lawrence)

sources.quote: vs #2 Connecticut Kansas City, Mo. W, 88-59 Jan 28 (Sat)

1995-16|site.note: Played at Kemper Arena in Kansas City, not Allen Fieldhouse; the record book prints 'at Kansas' (Kansas was the nominal host). Consistent with the earlier ruling on Fairfield-hosted games in New Haven (1988-22 = neutral), the venue makes it neutral, so the app (N) stands. Convention call, not a factual error either way.
